notes.title: Demolish & Build 3 Prologue is now ready to play for free!
notes.content:
[h1]The wait is over🏗️[/h1]

[h2]Demolish & Build 3 Prologue
is now ready to play for free on Steam:[/h2]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2803230/Demolish__Build_3_Prologue/

[h3]Gear up and prepare for the job with our Trailer:[/h3]
[previewyoutube=x5cV7m8rwSc;full][/previewyoutube]
[h3]Support the main release, Follow Demolish & Build 3 and add us to your Wishlist.[/h3]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1203670/Demolish__Build_3/
[h3]Thanks! The more the Wishlist and Follow the better discounts we can give at full game launch and later![/h3]

[h2]The release date of Demolish & Build 3 on PC (Steam) is set for Q2 2024. [/h2]

[h3]In 2025, the game will also be available on PlayStation 4, PlayStation 5, Xbox One, Xbox Series X|S and Nintendo Switch.
[/h3]

[b]Demolish & Build 3[/b] is a new installment of the construction and demolition owner company simulator series.

The gameplay focuses primarily on performing various demolition and construction works,             as well as developing and managing a business.

We are preparing, among others, a realistic destruction system.

Each fragment consists of a specific material with specific parameters of resistance to various types of damage. Even greater realism is ensured by taking into account the interaction of individual objects and structures.

In[b]Demolish & Build 3 Prologue[/b], you take your first steps into making a construction company by learning the ropes and operating hand tools, demolition hammer, and heavy machines on the job site. Do the job and earn your pay.

[b]Demolish & Build 3 Prologue[/b] will include the first few missions from the main release and features mostly but not only:

🚧 Vehicle controls based on real construction machines,
🚧 Physics-based track mechanics,
🚧 Large excavator,
🚧 Skid steer,
🚧 Specialized attachments for both vehicles,
🚧 Controller support,
🚧 Fully destructible objects and structures,
🚧 Third-person and first-person camera modes,

The main game will bring in the future:

🏗️Running and growing the company,
🏗️Randomly generated missions,
🏗️Varied locations,
🏗️Languages translations,
🏗️More tools and machines,

Join the crew on Discord or follow our channels for updates:
Discord: https://discord.gg/qJSWEk3vWs

Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/profile.php?id=100069086002960

X: https://twitter.com/DemolishGames

Yours faithfully,
[h3]Demolish Games S.A. “Demolish & Build 3” Team.[/h3]

notes.title: Demolish & Build 3 Prologue - Release Date Trailer
notes.content:
[h2]🏗️The site is ready, and the deal is set on both ends.[/h2]

Turn up the radio and mood for the job as heavy equipment is coming to do the heavy lifting. Tools and materials provided, bring your safety gloves and shoes and mark the day.

[h3][b]Demolish & Build 3 Prologue is set to start construction works on 
March 1st, 2024.[/b][/h3]

🥾⛑️🦺🧤🎧⚠️👷✅Ok, you are ready to go.
[previewyoutube=x5cV7m8rwSc;full]https://youtu.be/x5cV7m8rwSc[/previewyoutube]
Demolish & Build 3: Prologue will include the first few missions of the full game and features:

🚧 Large excavator.
🚧 Skid steer.
🚧 Attachments
🚧 Physics-based track mechanics,
🚧 Vehicle controls based on real machines.
🚧 Full controller support,
🚧 Fully destructible objects and structures
🚧 Third-person and first-person camera modes,

A Basic Manual Training course for future foremen can be accessed on the main website in the form of a playable demo: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1203670/Demolish__Build_3/

Basic excavator training is also provided: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2021130/Demolish__Build_3_Excavator_Playground/

Stay tuned for details of the contract. Stay cautious on the job site!

Dear Foremen,

Today is the day we lurk out of production to showcase what we were building in the last couple of months. Bringing this game together is a real challenge, but we are quite proud of what we have achieved so far and more than optimistic about what is to come.

In the upcoming weeks, we will share a little bit more of gamepad gameplay with vehicle controls and some other goodies.

We hope you'll enjoy it.

Yours,
Demolish & Build 3 Team.

notes.content:
[b][h2]Hello, demolishers![/h2][/b]

[b]We would like to apologize for the long silence. We are still working hard on Demolish & Build 3 and have a surprise for you. A new demo of our game will be available on June 19th, which you can test for free at Steam Next Fest June 2023! Excellent news, right?[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42179693/ba9d0e7764137588a88928d6a7d0369eda7aa8c6.png[/img]
[b]Check out the latest trailer of what awaits you in the upcoming demo.[/b]
https://youtu.be/FxOdq36R3Zw

In the demo version, your task will be to complete one full order. Who knows what surprises you will find there? Let's quickly introduce you to a few features:

- First-person player character (FPP)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42179693/93a8f8613225010ca6f4c7be2e9f2ef2c766dd60.png[/img]
- Improved damage system

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42179693/9fea18162b0394e01a39aa18b3d9aa97f76cb02f.png[/img]
- NEW! Player damage - Be careful how you demolish objects, falling fragments can injure the player

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42179693/aa4736b119b726fa7b071d63c9242ee502fd5b14.png[/img]
- NEW! Electrical installation 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42179693/28f597a82ed82ac0ee1a793f7a922f37fc882dbf.png[/img]
- Tools such as a jackhammer, sledgehammer, and electricity sensor

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42179693/62fb291088eaaef14e9383828984df68fc0c0bb0.png[/img]
What do you think about the changes? Don't forget to add our game to your wishlist so you don't miss the demo and main game release.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1203670

We will be grateful for any suggestions you can write to us on our Discord. We are creating this game for you and your opinion is very important to us!

[url=https://discord.gg/mp9fys3268][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26225940/2e8a36948df3ac59a88c8b713340816a0c19bf76.png[/img][/url]

Stay safe and happy demolition!
Demolish Games crew

notes.title: Update demo - full customization for controllers/joysticks/steering wheels
notes.content:
[h1]Demolishers![/h1]

[h3]Many of you have asked for the addition of full optimization for controllers. Especially for you, we have prepared an update related to these changes. As of now, you can assign any function to a button or axis in our [b]demo - Demolish & Build 3: Excavator Playground.[/b]

We took great care to create a system that is both flexible and easy to use. With it you can use any number and any type of controllers. Also, we did our best to allow you to assign whatever button or axis to every important function. In the future we will also add options to calibrate and fine-tune your axes to give you the best experience you can have.
[/h3]

[h3]In the instructions below, we show you how to setup custom controls.[/h3]

⦁	Select your controller here: 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42659669/827a46ffeaf897d30902fb68cc6c8d072d11195e.png[/img]

⦁	This button allows you to remove the current assignment.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42659669/a50b8412458f37ac25ea56f4e02c87bd8ef6cb33.png[/img]

⦁	To assign a button select a function…

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42659669/5ba6272b98a2fd4d1789b7e1c2165b6609b4e260.png[/img]

… and press the chosen button. Only buttons from the selected controller will be pooled. You can also assign an axis as a button (for ex. LT/RT on a controller).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42659669/f7fc7e76c868e7680b4cdd6e7079eeb28060a51e.png[/img]

⦁	To assign an axis, first select chosen function from the list

⦁	There are 4 modes available: Axis, Buttons, Axis with a modifier, Buttons with a modifier

⦁	Axis/Buttons
To assign simply select the function and use chosen axis or button

⦁	Axis/Buttons with Modifier
Axis/Buttons with Modifier is a special function that allows you to use the same controller axis for multiple functions. In practice, the Modifier works like a Shift Key – pressing it will override the default function and use this one instead.

[h2]EXAMPLE:[/h2]

Let’s use this method to setup the Xbox 360 controller to the SAE pattern instead of the default ISO. 
For the sake of this presentation, we’ll use an empty layout but you can just as easily modify an existing one.

⦁	Start by assigning button functions: 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42659669/c11052706f1d6ba05d8635245c0e112de53ccd65.png[/img]

⦁	Assign the RT/RB to the right track
⦁	Select [b]right track forward[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42659669/b2b80658989785a47da1ac5f40cef661105ee6e7.png[/img]

⦁	Select [b]no binding[/b] and press RT to assign it 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42659669/7855999a33ed2417cd88f55c3dc13429ffedb58c.png[/img]

⦁	Return to the list

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42659669/35e801d658684a4ec5f4bfa22c670165b2fb5bbe.png[/img]

⦁	Select the [b]right track backward [/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42659669/ab63b561cab02788323fd33d39aa21c7169d5b73.png[/img]

⦁	Choose [b]BUTTONS[/b] mode

⦁	Select [b]no binding[/b] next to [b]RIGHT TRACK BACKWARD[/b] + and assign RB

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42659669/8424eb2ee651fef8e4d564d3014202cf064c868c.png[/img]

⦁	Repeat the same for the left track

⦁	Select [b]rotate cabin (left, right)[/b], axis mode, and assign left stick X (horizontal) axis.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42659669/01bc472c24f90a05e9f7283fba39eb84bb9fb11a.png[/img]

⦁	Select rotate boom (up, down), axis mode, and assign left stick Y (vertical) axis.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42659669/67886d36c134266a61b68da0822f113d14ffb970.png[/img]

⦁	Now, let’s move on to the right stick. Select [b]extend attachment[/b], axis mode, and assign right stick X axis. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42659669/3369f479be2945866fca24bdbfa9d2ba4f39f214.png[/img]

⦁	Select [b]rotate arm (up, down)[/b], axis mode, and assign right stick Y axis.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42659669/9c178c0a8dc61d235cd9693a500332afb097e570.png[/img]

⦁	We also need to rotate the shears

⦁	Select [b]rotate attachment horizontally[/b]

⦁	Change mode to [b]BUTTONS[/b]

⦁	Assign D-Pad left/right to the appropriate functions

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42659669/627270aaadc50d6e27e3a8c78c26c53aebd4bae2.png[/img]

⦁	That leaves us with camera controls. Since we’ve already assigned all controller axes we’ll use the modifier.

⦁	Select [b]rotate camera[/b]

⦁	Choose [b]AXIS WITH MODIFIER[/b] mode

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42659669/dc7cf061c25847d3d5864aa93f8086bd25d55dae.png[/img]

⦁	First assign the left stick button to the [b]MODIFIER[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42659669/9432e6e77ac5691775b3e5ad36d1fd618715e2e0.png[/img]

⦁	Now let’s assign the right stick axes to both functions
This means that when we press the right stick button the left stick will control the camera instead of the excavator’s left joystick.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42659669/85e35570d361f55ffc4d12305ac6a0b65bbbf8a2.png[/img]

⦁	Repeat the same steps for [b]camera zoom[/b] with the right stick button and left stick y.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42659669/f937f0a623803e98f607ba263e92b3e3bfe610bb.png[/img]

That’s it. We’ve created working SAE controls for our controller from scratch.


Some additional rules/tips when creating custom control schemes:

⦁	A single axis can be assigned to only one function without modifiers.
⦁	You cannot use the same button for the modifier and a normal function.
⦁	On the other hand, a button can be used as a modifier for multiple functions.
⦁	You do not have to assign every function for a single controller.
⦁	If you want to assign a full axis to one of the tracks, best assign it to the [b]left/right track forward [/b]functions.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1203670

[h3]If you have any suggestions, or ideas about the game, please write to us. Join our discord:[/h3]

[url=https://discord.gg/mp9fys3268][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26225940/2e8a36948df3ac59a88c8b713340816a0c19bf76.png[/img][/url]

[h3]Stay safe and happy demolition!
Demolish Games crew[/h3]

notes.title: Demolish & Build 3: Excavator Playground Release!
notes.content:
[h2]This day has come![/h2]

[h1]Demolish & Build 3: Excavator Playground - play the demo now![/h1]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2021130

[h2]Watch the trailer here:[/h2]

[previewyoutube=oC2o8nbJn9M;full][/previewyoutube]

[b]Demolish & Build 3: Excavator Playground[/b] is a playable sneak peek at the driving and demolition physics from the upcoming [b]Demolition & Build 3[/b]. In the game, you take control of a modern excavator and drive around a small test track or demolish structures.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42659669/f3f8843d4c8c474cc685d4ba756adb13b38f18c8.jpg[/img]

[b]Demolish & Build 3[/b] will include brand new demolition and driving physics. This short tech demo allows you to try them out before the final release.

[h2][b]The full version of the game - Demolish & Build 3 is coming in 2023.[/b][/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42659669/4f5c69e21a993b6768d21cfed6e379ca121ce2c7.jpg[/img]

[b]Some of the main features of Demolish & Build 3: Excavator Playground include:[/b]
[list] 
[*] A large excavator equipped with demolition shears
[*] Vehicle controls based on real excavators
[*] Vehicle controls based on real excavators
[*] Physics-based track mechanics
[*] Full controller support
[*] Fully destructible objects
[*] A small test track
[*] Ramps
[*] Concrete structures that can be demolished
[*] Third-person and first-person camera modes
[*] And more…
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42659669/c27cb6d9cfdc3c68cc4b0ea8264dce899bb2b20d.jpg[/img]

[h2]Play the demo now and send us your feedback![/h2]

[url=https://discord.gg/mp9fys3268][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26225940/2e8a36948df3ac59a88c8b713340816a0c19bf76.png[/img][/url]

Cheers!
Demolish Games Team
